LanguageData.LP_ImmovableRod.label: immovable rod
LanguageData.LP_ImmovableRod.description: A plain iron rod with a button at one end. Put it on the ground, select it and "press" the button: the rod locks in place, becoming an indestructible, impassable obstacle on one cell, for blocking doors and tunnels or stopping minotaur charges; press again ("retract") to turn it back into a movable rod.
LanguageData.LP_ImmovableRodActive.label: pressed immovable rod
LanguageData.LP_ImmovableRodActive.description: An immovable rod with its button pressed, fixed firmly in midair; nothing can push or break it. Select it and "retract" to turn it back into an item.
LanguageData.LP_DecanterEndlessWater.label: decanter of endless water
LanguageData.LP_DecanterEndlessWater.description: A blue-glazed porcelain flask whose mouth always seeps water; set on the ground it's a little spring. Plants within 3 cells grow +20% faster; "spray" once per day puts out all fires within 3 cells (saves your own trolls). Can be moved.
LanguageData.LP_EverburningTorch.label: everburning torch
LanguageData.LP_EverburningTorch.description: A torch whose flame never goes out and isn't hot at all, hung on the belt. The wearer always has light around them; it's not real fire, can't ignite anything, and trolls holding it don't count as "burned".
LanguageData.LP_HornValhalla.label: horn of valhalla
LanguageData.LP_HornValhalla.description: A silver-banded horn. Blowing the "horn of valhalla" summons 2-4 spirit warriors (translucent shadow warriors with longswords) that dissipate after 1 hour; when a lich blows it, skeleton warriors come instead. Once every 7 days. Hung at the waist in the trinket layer (shares the slot with other horns).
LanguageData.LP_BagOfTricks.label: bag of tricks
LanguageData.LP_BagOfTricks.description: A small grey woolen bag. Once per day you can "reach in": pull out a random small animal (rat, rabbit, cat...), docile toward you, that vanishes into thin air after 24 hours. Useful as a scout or a decoy.
LanguageData.LP_CrystalBall.label: crystal ball
LanguageData.LP_CrystalBall.description: A crystal ball on an ebony stand, with mist slowly swirling inside. Once per day you can "scry": pick a settlement on the world map, and a letter says which faction it belongs to, what race guards it and roughly how many threat points the garrison is. Only sold by Red Wizard merchants of Thay.
LanguageData.LP_ManualOfGolems.label: golem manual
LanguageData.LP_ManualOfGolems.description: A thick book with stone slab covers, describing how to call stone into servitude. Only liches can understand it: after a lich reads it, the necromantic ritual table unlocks "make stone golem seed" for them (the fourth necromantic construct: 300 stone blocks, body size 2, doesn't eat, sleep or rot). The book crumbles into stone dust once read.
LanguageData.LP_StoneGolem.label: stone golem
LanguageData.LP_StoneGolem.description: A stone golem awakened by necromantic ritual and commanded by the phylactery's owner. Doesn't eat, sleep or rot.
LanguageData.LP_StoneGolemSeed.label: stone golem seed
LanguageData.LP_StoneGolemSeed.description: A necromantic seed built of stone blocks and carved with golem runes. Select it and open "configure necromantic construct" to adjust extra raw meat, steel, plasteel and starting stats, then confirm to awaken it. Materials are absorbed from reachable, unforbidden ground items within 12 cells.
LanguageData.LP_ScrollRemoveCurse.label: scroll of remove curse
LanguageData.LP_ScrollRemoveCurse.description: Read on a person or a cursed item: removes the curse from one cursed item (identifying it as well). Afterwards it can be taken off or put down normally, with effects and costs unchanged. Sold by church priests, copyable at the scroll desk, and liches can also copy it at the necromantic ritual table.
